transcripts.text:
Interviewer: Can you walk me through how your team reviews articles?
Participant: We usually split the reading across two people, then compare notes in a shared document.
Interviewer: What makes that process difficult?
Participant: The hardest part is noticing when we used different labels for the same idea.
Interviewer: What would make the coding tool useful?
Participant: I would want quick topic editing, clear exports, and a way to return to the same session tomorrow.
